name: cowart-thinking-canvas
description: The official Excalidraw editor with optional Codex Agent generation of native editable diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: Official Excalidraw with project trees and optional native editable AI diagrams.
interface.longDescription: Yogurt AI embeds the official Excalidraw editor, adds a parent-child multi-canvas project tree in the official Sidebar, and keeps the AI layer completely optional. Every canvas persists independently. With AI off, users retain the standard Excalidraw tools, style panel, shortcuts, and native document model. With AI on, Codex Agent generates native rectangles with bound text, frames, and bound arrows using html-line-svg layout rules; every generated element stays individually selectable, movable, resizable, restylable, editable, deletable, and reconnectable.
capabilities: Official Excalidraw editor runtime and UI
Native editable cards, frames, text, and bound arrows
Deterministic layout and obstacle-aware arrow routing
